comments.author: RvZ
comments.body:
Quest name: A Man Called Genghis Khan (Chrono Quest - 14th Century)
Quest location: Calicut Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r15 Search, r17 Archaeology, CHN(Chinese)
Pre-requisite discovery: The Treasure of Batu discovery (from "Western progress of the nomads" quest) + The secret history of the Mongols discovery (from "History book of the Yuan dynasty" quest)
Additional notes: "Aftermath" part of Xanadu/Great Adventurer questchain

comments.author: Morro
comments.body: Chinese is either mandatory or heavily influences the rate of appearance for this quest. Quest wouldn't appear without it. Appeared instantly after getting the language with a World Language Reader
